event_description: User submits a question to the AI answer flow from the main chat panel.
AI answer stream finishes and the turn result is ready for the user.
Owner lands on the claim form page, indicating intent to list or claim a business page.
Owner successfully submits the claim form and the service page is published.
Visitor navigates to the inquiry form for a specific business listing.
Visitor successfully submits a first-contact inquiry to a business owner.
Visitor views a business listing page that has an active inquiry contact path.
Visitor clicks 'View details' on a business result in the service registry.
Owner initiates the paid activation checkout flow from the billing activation page.
Billing webhook successfully processed a provider event (server-side).
